title: The Hurt Locker
description: As their tour of duty winds down, a bomb disposal unit in Baghdad faces increasingly perilous situations that could end their lives in an instant.

title: The Hunger Games
description: In a place once known as North America, youths fight to the death in a nationally televised contest.

description: As rebellion simmers, a cruel change in the Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

description: Katniss and friends embark on a mission to assassinate President Snow and liberate war-torn Panem.
